question:
Select the option that correctly rectifies the underlined spelling error.

He received an __honarary__ degree for his contributions.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Honorary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"honarary"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"honorary"**, which means conferred as an honor, without the usual requirements or duties. (मानद)

 
 
• **Example:** She was awarded an honorary doctorate for her contributions to science.
 
 
 
• **"Honorary"** refers to a title or position given as an honor without requiring the performance of usual duties. (मानद)
 
 
• **Example:** He was made an honorary member of the club for his dedication to its activities.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct spelling is **"Honorary"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Honorary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Honoury** (मानद): Incorrect spelling of "honorary." No valid usage exists.
 
• **Honourary** (मानद): A British English variation of "honorary," though "honorary" is more commonly accepted globally.
 
 
• **Example:** He received an honourary title for his contributions to the arts.
 
 
 
• **Hononary** (मानद): Incorrect spelling; not a valid word in English.
